paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of the object population frequency (o_pop), with the x-axis labeled as "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranging from 1 to 19 in increments of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," spans from 0.0 to 1.0. Two metrics are presented: "Initial Accuracy," represented by a green line with square markers, and "Final Accuracy," represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers. The initial accuracy fluctuates between approximately 0.3 and 0.5, showing a peak around o_pop frequency 5 and a trough around 7. In contrast, the final accuracy consistently remains higher, ranging from about 0.6 to 0.9, with a noticeable peak at an o_pop frequency of 9 and a secondary peak near 15. Error bars are present for both metrics, indicating variability in the measurements.
